descriptionChirho: The indeclinable surname or epithet Ἰσκαριώθ/Ἰσκαριώτης applied to Judas (and once to his father Simon), designating him as 'the man from Kerioth' or similar toponymic origin. All three clusters represent the same proper noun with only minor spelling/transliteration variation across the NT manuscripts (Iskariōtēs vs Iskariōth). Multilingual evidence confirms identity: eng 'Iskariōtēs/Iskariōth', spa 'Iskariōtēs/Iskariṓth', hin इस्करियोती/इस्करियोत, arb الْإِسْخَرْيُوطِيُّ, kor 가룟인/이스가리옷, swa 'Iskariōtēs/Iskariṓth'. No semantic distinction exists between the clusters.
